integrity: Proof steps, one-sided local-time normalization, stationary-throughput meaning, and numerical checks are documented in RESULT.md and checker.py. Mathematical originality is same-model assessed only; publication priority and independent review are not certified.
limitations: The result assumes reflected one-dimensional Brownian motion, independent Poisson relocations to positive sites, and cumulative (non-reset) local time. The exact sharp cusp is for two reset sites and long-time local-time throughput, not a finite surface-reaction threshold or an arbitrary reset-time distribution. Numerical tests are finite diagnostics. Broader unindexed two-exponential optimization antecedents cannot be ruled out.
title: A sharp two-site cusp for boundary-reaction throughput under position-only resetting
